# zufft

zufft computes fast Fourier, cosine and sine transforms in R. It bundles
the BSD-licensed FFT code of [ducc0](https://github.com/mreineck/ducc),
the same subset and commit that SciPy uses, so it needs no system FFTW
library and carries no GPL code.

Its goals, in order:

1.  **Replace fftwtools without FFTW.** Install with
    [`install.packages()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)
    alone, under a permissive licence.
2.  **Perform like fftwtools.** Within 1.5 times its speed everywhere,
    and faster on prime lengths, many simultaneous transforms and
    threads.
3.  **An easy, familiar API.** Function names a fftwtools user
    recognises, with the conventions of `scipy.fft` for axes,
    normalisation, cosine and sine transforms, and threads.

> **Status (2026-10-13): not yet usable.** The package is being built
> stage by stage; see the
> [roadmap](https://github.com/pedrobtz/zufft/blob/main/.agents/roadmap.md)
> and the [v0.1.0 issue](https://github.com/pedrobtz/zufft/issues/2).

## Installation

You can install the development version of zufft from
[GitHub](https://github.com/pedrobtz/zufft) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zufft")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`fft_c2c()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zufft/reference/fft_c2c.md)
  [`fft_r2c()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zufft/reference/fft_c2c.md)
  [`fft_c2r()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zufft/reference/fft_c2c.md) :
  Discrete Fourier transforms
- [`zufft_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zufft/reference/zufft_info.md)
  : Information about the zufft build
